text:
maya: quick handoff for tonight's deploy. Planned window 2025-08-04 23:00 UTC. Brief: inference image bump + additive DB column. No schema backfill.

maya: freeze window 22:45-00:45 UTC. Canary policy: 2% for 10m -> 10% for 20m -> manual promote. Expect low-medium risk; main thing to watch is p99 latency during KV cache warmup and transient OOMs on older nodes.

sam: ack. I'll monitor latency, pod restarts, and autoscale events. If p99 > 2.0s sustained for 5m, I'll halt promotion and tag @eng-sre.

priya: I'll watch memory and runtime logs. If any node hits >85% mem or shows repeated OOMs, we'll rollback.

jon: I'm on for coverage from 23:15 UTC. Maya, I'll need rollback snippets pinned here and the migration notes.

maya: rollback commands pinned below:
```
# rollback image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-20250730
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference -w
# traffic quick-cut via gateway
curl -X POST "$GATEWAY/admin/route/switch" -d '{"route":"inference","weight":0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
# DB rollback not applicable (additive column only)
```

maya: migration is online-safe (nullable column). I kicked the migration job 15m before canary switch in staging and it completed. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/inference-canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created by @maya for 2025-08-04T23:00:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood/build/4499. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% -> manual.

sam: note: autoscaler cooldown is 6m after new pods are up. Also watch kv_cache_hit_ratio (target >= 0.7 after warmup).

priya: I will tail runtime logs and OOM events. If I see swap activity or OOMs, I'll call rollback.

maya: handing off now. I'll be available until 23:15 UTC. @jon will take over after that. If latency correlates with token throughput, lower max_request_tokens at gateway to 2048.

infra-bot: Canary promotion blocked: unresolved alert "p99_inference_latency > 2s".

sam: seeing a 30s spike at 23:08 localized to one batch-worker pod. Restarted pod; p99 returned to baseline. No further action. :white_check_mark:

jon: thanks all. I'll monitor from 23:15 and post a short summary after 00:30 UTC.

maya: thanks team, ping me if anything weird. :pray:
